A01.remediation: Deny by default. Verify ownership / role on every route that reads a user id. Centralise authorization in middleware, not in the controller.

A02.remediation: Use bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, sha-256+ for general hashing, HTTPS-only URLs, crypto.randomBytes for tokens, and load secrets from a managed store (env, KMS, vault).

A03.remediation: Use parameterised queries, never concatenate user input into SQL. Avoid eval / new Function. Sanitise HTML or use safe DOM APIs (textContent) instead of innerHTML.

A04.remediation: Apply per-IP and per-account rate limits on auth endpoints. Resolve security-related TODO/FIXME comments before shipping.

A05.remediation: Lock down CORS to explicit origins, disable debug in production, ship default-deny settings and helmet-style security headers.

A07.remediation: Use bcrypt/argon2 for password hashing, constant-time comparison, enforce MFA, and rotate any leaked signing keys.

A08.remediation: Verify JWT signatures, sign CI artefacts and lock down auto-update channels.

A09.remediation: Add structured logging on auth, authorization and data-modification events with user id, IP and timestamp.

A10.remediation: Validate and allowlist outbound URLs, resolve DNS yourself to block private/loopback addresses, and disable HTTP redirections on the HTTP client.

owaspRemediation.A01: Add authorization middleware to every route that reads a user id. Use ownership checks like `if (resource.ownerId !== req.user.id) return res.status(403)`. Never trust the client.
owaspRemediation.A02: Replace md5/sha1 with bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, sha-256+ for general hashing. Move secrets to env / vault. Use crypto.randomBytes for tokens.
owaspRemediation.A03: Use parameterised queries (`db.query('SELECT … WHERE id = ?', [id])`). Replace eval / new Function with explicit dispatch. Use textContent over innerHTML.
owaspRemediation.A04: Plan abuse cases up-front. Add rate-limits to auth endpoints with `express-rate-limit`.
owaspRemediation.A05: Restrict CORS to known origins, disable debug in production, enable helmet() with default config and HSTS.
owaspRemediation.A07: Compare passwords with bcrypt.compare. Pin jwt algorithms: `jwt.verify(token, secret, { algorithms: ['HS256'] })`. Enforce MFA on sensitive accounts.
owaspRemediation.A08: Verify every JWT. Never disable signature verification. Sign CI artefacts.
owaspRemediation.A09: Use a structured logger (winston / pino) and log auth + admin events with user id, IP, timestamp, outcome.
owaspRemediation.A10: Validate and allowlist outbound URLs. Resolve DNS yourself to block private/loopback addresses. Disable HTTP redirects on the HTTP client.
